item.stem:
Rohan must construct an exact $15^{\circ}$ angle at point $A$ on ray $AX$ in the diagram, using equal-radius arcs and angle bisection.

Which two claims correctly describe the plan?

options.A: Name ray $AX$ as the finished $15^{\circ}$ angle, and stop before drawing any arcs.
options.B: Build a $60^{\circ}$ angle at $A$ with equal-radius arcs that form an equilateral triangle.
options.C: Bisect that $60^{\circ}$ angle to $30^{\circ}$, then bisect again to obtain $15^{\circ}$.
options.D: The repeated bisections are what create the equal-radius arcs of the equilateral step.
